summary: Comprehensive testing of About page and Blog system features. All backend APIs (13/13 tests) and frontend UI tests passed. About page shows 6 leadership cards and 6 office cards. Blog system has two-way filtering by destination and category working correctly. Blog admin CRUD operations verified.
passed_tests: About page (/about) loads with hero, stats, company info, leadership, offices, and CTA sections
About page shows 6 leadership cards (Founder & Chairman, CEO, SVP Sales, Head of Product, SVP Global Markets, CFO)
About page shows 6 office cards (India, Egypt, Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, Jordan)
Blog listing page (/blog) shows destination filter pills and category filter pills
Blog listing page shows 12 seeded articles
Clicking 'India' destination filter shows only 2 India articles
Clicking 'Cuisine' category filter shows only 3 Cuisine articles
Clicking India + Cuisine shows only 1 Indian cuisine article (must-try-street-foods-delhi)
Blog post page (/blog/must-try-street-foods-delhi) loads with full article content
Blog post page shows destination (India) and category (Cuisine) tags
Blog admin (/admin/blog) shows all 12 posts with create/edit/delete functionality
Navbar shows Blog and About links (6 total nav links: Destinations, Services, Technology, Webinars, Blog, About)
GET /api/blog returns posts with destinations and categories arrays (12+ posts)
GET /api/blog?destination=India returns only 2 India posts
GET /api/blog?category=Cuisine returns only 3 Cuisine posts
GET /api/blog?destination=India&category=Cuisine returns 1 post
GET /api/blog/must-try-street-foods-delhi returns single post with full content
POST /api/blog creates a new post with auto-generated slug
DELETE /api/blog/{id} deletes a post
GET /api/admin/blog returns all posts with total count
Duplicate slug creation correctly returns 400 error
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 12 seeded blog posts from blog_seed.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new features fully tested: (1) About page at /about with 6 leadership cards (Founder & Chairman, CEO, SVP Sales & Key Accounts, Head of Product, SVP Global Markets, CFO) and 6 office cards (India, Egypt, Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, Jordan). (2) Blog system with two-way tagging - 12 seeded articles across 8 destinations (Greece, India, Indonesia, Japan, Morocco, South Africa, Thailand, UAE) and 3 categories (Cuisine, Hotels, Experiences). Blog admin at /admin/blog for CRUD. All APIs working: GET /api/blog, GET /api/blog?destination=X&category=Y, GET /api/blog/{slug}, POST /api/blog, PUT /api/blog/{id}, DELETE /api/blog/{id}, GET /api/admin/blog.
